correctness.rationale: For 0<p<1, theta∈(0,2pi), channel contraction gives one stationary qubit with coherence z=p/[1-(1-p)e^{i theta}]. The full-rank equatorial SLD formula yields the rational QFI in x=p/(1-p), t=sin²(theta/2). Independently SymPy factorization checked dF/dx=xP_t(x)/A^4 identically, and at t=1 F=x²/(x+2)^4, unique maximizer x=2, F=1/64. Descartes one sign change of P_t across 0<t≤1 plus endpoint signs proves exactly one simple positive root. Scaling x=delta*y yields limiting -4y^4+4y²+2 with unique positive root and optimum QFI constant 2sqrt3/9. The excluded identity resonance is rank-changing; finite-difference SLD tests in inspected source do not replace proof.
